accounts.josh: Riley Navarro, HST of Lantern Bay

notes: Captured from the archivist sandbox (~/owbn/_localwp-oat) after seed-help-shots.php; the ids in paths are that seed's. OAT screens are English-only, so the Portuguese pages reuse these images with Portuguese alt text.

alt.en: The Archivist Dashboard for an HST: three requests waiting on him, three he watches that changed this week, the Archivist emails choice set to one for each update, then the counts (three waiting, four he filed, twelve he watches) and buttons for New Submission, View Inbox and Registry.
alt.pt_BR: O Archivist Dashboard de um HST: três pedidos esperando por ele, três que ele acompanha e que mudaram nesta semana, a escolha de emails do Arquivista em um por atualização, depois as contagens (três esperando, quatro registrados por ele, doze acompanhados) e os botões New Submission, View Inbox e Registry.

alt.en: The Archivist Inbox on Assigned to Me: three requests at Staff Review, each with who filed it, its domain, status, step and date, and a View button.
alt.pt_BR: O Archivist Inbox em Assigned to Me: três pedidos em Staff Review, cada um com quem o registrou, o domínio, o status, a etapa e a data, e um botão View.

alt.en: Submit a Request with Character Lifecycle and R&U Request picked: the chronicle, the character picker with Create New Character, Character Status and the Regulation Rules picker.
alt.pt_BR: Fazer um Pedido com Character Lifecycle e R&U Request escolhidos: a crônica, o seletor de personagem com Create New Character, Character Status e o seletor de Regulation Rules.

alt.en: An R&U request at Coordinator Review, seen by the Brujah Coordinator: its status and step, who filed it, the chronicle, the character, the rule it falls under and its controlling Coordinator.
alt.pt_BR: Um pedido de R&U em Coordinator Review, visto pela Coordenadora Brujah: o status e a etapa, quem o registrou, a crônica, o personagem, a regra em que ele se encaixa e o Coordenador que o controla.

alt.en: The Archivist Registry for an HST on the Chronicles tab, with Lantern Bay open: six characters with their chronicle and status, and Display Options for more columns.
alt.pt_BR: O Archivist Registry de um HST na aba Chronicles, com Lantern Bay aberta: seis personagens com a crônica e o status, e Display Options para mais colunas.

alt.en: A Character Record open to its HST: name, chronicle, the Genre, Faction and Type pickers, PC/NPC, Status, Player Name and Email, and the Linked Account with Unlink.
alt.pt_BR: Uma Ficha do Personagem aberta para o HST: nome, crônica, os seletores de Genre, Faction e Type, PC/NPC, Status, Player Name e Email, e a Linked Account com Unlink.

alt.en: The Creature row of a Camarilla character whose Type reads "Tzimisce (Sect Defector)", with the note on what changing the Faction does.
alt.pt_BR: A linha Creature de um personagem da Camarilla cujo Type mostra "Tzimisce (Sect Defector)", com a nota sobre o que acontece ao mudar a Faction.

alt.en: The Fame Registry: famous characters with their public identity, Fame level, influence areas and chronicle.
alt.pt_BR: O Fame Registry: personagens famosos com a identidade pública, o nível de Fama, as áreas de influência e a crônica.

alt.en: ccHub's browse page, open to everyone: approved custom content with its type, XP cost, Coordinator and chronicle.
alt.pt_BR: A página de busca do ccHub, aberta a todos: conteúdo personalizado aprovado com o tipo, o custo de XP, o Coordenador e a crônica.

alt.en: OAT Reports in wp-admin: the report picker and the counts of requests by domain and status.
alt.pt_BR: OAT Reports no wp-admin: o seletor de relatório e as contagens de pedidos por domínio e status.

alt.en: The Timeline of an approved registration: filed, approved at Staff Review, approved by the Archivist, each with who, when and the note.
alt.pt_BR: A Timeline de um registro aprovado: registrado, aprovado em Staff Review, aprovado pelo Arquivista, cada passo com quem, quando e a nota.

alt.en: All Entries: every request with its domain, form, status, step, chronicle and dates, filters on top.
alt.pt_BR: All Entries: todos os pedidos com domínio, formulário, status, etapa, crônica e datas, com filtros no topo.

alt.en: The Archivist Toolbox with its Domains, Forms, Workflow Steps and Form Fields tabs.
alt.pt_BR: O Archivist Toolbox com as abas Domains, Forms, Workflow Steps e Form Fields.

alt.en: The Domains tab: each domain with its label, slug, forms and status.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Domains: cada domínio com o rótulo, o slug, os formulários e o status.

alt.en: The Forms tab: each form with its domain, label, slug and status, and Manage Form Fields.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Forms: cada formulário com o domínio, o rótulo, o slug e o status, e Manage Form Fields.

alt.en: The Form Fields of the R&U Request form: each field's key, label, type, whether it is required, and its order.
alt.pt_BR: Os Form Fields do formulário R&U Request: a chave, o rótulo, o tipo, se é obrigatório e a ordem de cada campo.

alt.en: The Workflow Steps of Character Lifecycle: each step with who it goes to and where approving, denying or sending it back leads.
alt.pt_BR: Os Workflow Steps de Character Lifecycle: cada etapa com para quem vai e para onde levam aprovar, negar ou devolver.

alt.en: The Regulation Rules tab: the R&U list with each item's genre, category, item, PC and NPC levels and controlling Coordinator.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Regulation Rules: a lista de R&U com o gênero, a categoria, o item, os níveis de PC e NPC e o Coordenador de cada item.

alt.en: Submission Rules: each rule with what it checks, what it does and the message members see.
alt.pt_BR: Submission Rules: cada regra com o que confere, o que faz e a mensagem que os membros veem.

alt.en: The Creature Taxonomy tab: genres, their factions, and the types and variants on each list.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Creature Taxonomy: os gêneros, as facções de cada um, e os tipos e variantes de cada lista.

alt.en: Archivist Settings, General tab: the role patterns allowed to create characters.
alt.pt_BR: Archivist Settings, aba General: os padrões de cargo que podem criar personagens.
